ai.title: CLI API client respects httpproxy env vars
ai.summary: Added proxy support to `createCodebuffApiClient` in `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts`. The client now resolves proxy URLs from `HTTPS_PROXY`, `https_proxy`, `HTTP_PROXY`, or `http_proxy` env vars, or explicit config. Pass `proxy: null` to disable. Applies to all API calls via Bun's `fetch` proxy option.

eli5.text: If you run the assistant from the command line at work, it can now route its internet traffic through your company's proxy server. When you start it, it looks for a proxy address in your system settings (HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, and lowercase versions) or in its own configuration file, and if it finds one, it sends all its web requests through that proxy instead of directly. You can still turn this off by explicitly telling it not to use any proxy, and everything works the same once the traffic reaches the proxy.
